# laravelforge_site_inertia (Resource)

Enables the Inertia SSR integration on a Laravel Forge site. This is a per-site singleton; the API has no delete endpoint, so destroying this resource only removes it from state and leaves the integration enabled.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server that hosts the site.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site to enable the Inertia integration on.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (String) Whether the Inertia integration is enabled.
- `inertia_installed` (Boolean) Whether Inertia is installed for the site.
